title: NarmestelederLeesah
description: Value of a non-tombstone record on team-esyfo.syfo-narmesteleder-leesah. One record describes the current state of one narmesteleder relation. All properties are always present; nullable properties are written as null. Properties may be added, so consumers must ignore unknown properties.

narmesteLederId.description: Id of the narmesteleder relation. Same value as the record key.

fnr.description: National identity number of the employee (arbeidstaker).

narmesteLederFnr.description: National identity number of the narmeste leder.

narmesteLederTelefonnummer.description: Phone number of the narmeste leder, as registered by the employer.

narmesteLederEpost.description: Email address of the narmeste leder, as registered by the employer.

aktivFom.description: First day the relation is active.

aktivTom.description: Last day the relation is active. null while the relation is active.

arbeidsgiverForskutterer.description: Whether the employer continues to pay salary during sick leave. null when unknown.

timestamp.description: When the record was published, in UTC.

status.description: Source of the latest change. The examples are the values produced today; new values may be added, so consumers should map unknown values to a fallback.
